title: WPSS/445/2018 of Smt. Sarita Kukshal Vs State Of Uttarakhand Through Secretary Department Of Silk AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 445 of 2018
Smt. Sarita Kukshal Ö Petitioner
Vs
State of Uttarakhand & others Ö Respondent s
Mr. Raman Kumar Sah, Advocate, present for the petitioner.
Ms. Anjali Bhargawa, Brief Holder, present for the State of Uttarakhand.

Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J. (Oral)
1. Petitionerís husband ñ Sri Anil Kumar Kukshal was
appointed as Assistant Teacher in Government Primary
School, District Almora and he was posted in Government
Primary School, Tol Budhani, Block Syalde, District Almora.
2. Perusal of the appointment order dated 22.09.2009,
indicates that the appointment given to petitionerís husband
was regular in nature. It transpires that petitionerís husband
died on 23.01.2011 under suspicious circumstances in Sult
Block of District Almora, therefore, the matter was reported
to the police. Soon after death of her husband, petitioner
made an application for compassionate appointment to the
Competent Authority, as is apparent from the letter dated
06.05.2013 issued by Chief Education Officer, Almora to the
petitioner. By the said letter, Chief Education Officer has
informed the petitioner that her application for
compassionate appointment was forwarded to Competent
Authority on 06.02.2013, however, the Additional Director of
Education has returned the said application vide letter dated
22.04.2013 on the ground of pendency of criminal case in the
court of Judicial Magistrate, Bhikyasen.
3. In the present writ petition, petitioner has
challenged the order dated 25.01.2018 passed by Regional
Additional Director of Education, Nainital, whereby her claim
for compassionate appointment has been rejected only on the
ground of delay. In the impugned order, it is stated that
petitionerís husband died on 23.01.2011 and the application

2
made by her, seeking compassionate appointment, is beyond
the period of five years as prescribed under the Dying in
Harness Rules 1974, therefore, it is not possible to consider
petitionerís claim for compassionate appointment at this
belated stage.
4. Respondent Nos. 2 and 3 have filed a counter
affidavit, wherein they have reiterated the stand taken in the
impugned order dated 25.01.2018. However, the statement
of fact, made by petitioner in her writ petition have not been
disputed in the counter affidavit. In para 6 of the writ
petition, petitioner had stated that she applied for
compassionate appointment in the year 2011 and in para 7 of
the writ petition, reference to the letter of Chief Education
Officer, Almora dated 06.05.2013 has been made. The said
letter corroborates statement of the petitioner that she had
applied for compassionate appointment soon after death of
her husband. However, in the counter affidavit neither the
statement, made in para 6 and 7 of the writ petition, have
been disputed nor issuance of letter dated 06.05.2013 by
Chief Education Officer, Almora has been denied.
5. Since, the facts pleaded in the writ petition,
particularly those pleaded in para 6 and 7 of the writ petition
are unrebutted, therefore, this Court has no option, but to
accept them, as correct. Thus, the only logical inference
would be that petitioner had applied for compassionate
appointment soon after death of her husband, and at any
rate, before 06.05.2013, therefore, there was no delay on her
part in making application for compassionate appointment.
Thus the reason assigned in the impugned order cannot be
sustained, hence, the impugned order dated 25.01.2018 is
liable to be quashed and is hereby quashed.

3
6. The writ petition is, therefore, allowed. Since
petitioner had applied for compassionate appointment within
time and the delay in taking decision on her application is
not attributable to her, therefore, respondent No. 2 is directed
to reconsider petitionerís claim on merits, in accordance with
law, within three weeks from the date of presentation of
certified copy of this order.
(Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
11.07.2018
Aswal
